Title: Meridian Loan Origination: SERVICE_TASK kyc-aml-check inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork never dispatched; instance stalls ACTIVE (UAT WF05-FULL3-20261001 F1). Severity MAJOR. Symptom: meridian Loan Origination v1.1 on QA: after credit-memo-review (ben) and risk-assessment (miriam) complete, current_nodes=[kyc-aml-check]; instance ACTIVE >6.5min (past 300s timeout_ms) with no task, no SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED event, no EXECUTION_ERROR, no DLQ row; endpoint answers 200 directly; top-level service tasks complete in 2-6s. Suspect SERVICE_TASK activation inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork branch (cf. ISS-0398 walk_to_gateway, resolved): likely no service_task_dispatches row armed on the fork/join walk path (Letflow.Engine fork activation / arm_service_task_dispatch call sites / TaskActivation). ALSO: kyc-routing has no unconditional edge and the stub endpoint returns no kyc_status, so the token may stall at kyc-routing even once dispatched -- assess whether fixture/process-definition issue (test/fixtures/qa/ meridian loan origination definition); handle or file separately. Acceptance: SERVICE_TASK nodes on a PARALLEL_GATEWAY branch are dispatched and recorded; meridian loan-origination scenarios reach committee/L1 routing and complete; regression test fail-first reproducing the stall at engine level. Evidence: test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-WF05-FULL3-20261001-NARRATIVE.yaml (on PR #2129 branch origin/pr2129 only). Q-926 (body_template rendering) is DONE and merged on main -- build on it.
